content_html:
Visiting Machu Picchu today is very different from a few years ago.

Access is now organized through mandatory circuits with specific routes, meaning you can no longer explore the site freely.

Choosing the wrong ticket doesn’t just limit your visit…
it can make you miss the most important parts of the experience.

How many types of Machu Picchu tickets are there?

Currently, there are:

  • 3 main circuits
  • More than 10 official routes within them

These circuits were designed to control visitor flow and protect the site.

The 3 circuits are:

Circuit 1 – Panoramic

  • Focused on upper viewpoints
  • Includes routes such as:
    • Machu Picchu Mountain
    • Inti Punku (Sun Gate)
  • Ideal for panoramic photos

It does not always include a full city tour.

Circuit 2 – Classic (Most Complete)

  • Includes:
    • Main urban area (temples, plazas)
    • The iconic postcard viewpoint

Considered the best option for first-time visitors

This is the most requested ticket.

Circuit 3 – Royalty (Lower area + add-ons)

  • Covers important temples in the lower section
  • Includes access to:
    • Huayna Picchu
    • Huchuy Picchu
    • Great Cavern

It does NOT include the classic panoramic viewpoint

Most important ticket types

1. Machu Picchu Ticket (Circuit 2 – Classic)

Includes:

  • The famous postcard photo
  • Visit to the main temples
  • Full Machu Picchu experience

Best option for first-time visitors.

2. Machu Picchu + Huayna Picchu

Includes:

  • Circuit 3 (lower Machu Picchu area)
  • Hike to Huayna Picchu mountain

Important:

  • Physically demanding hike
  • Only for travelers aged 12+
  • Very limited availability

Recommended to book at least 3 months in advance

Does not include the classic photo viewpoint

3. Machu Picchu + Machu Picchu Mountain

Includes:

  • Circuit 1 (upper areas)
  • Hike to Machu Picchu Mountain

Features:

  • Longer hike than Huayna Picchu
  • Less steep and safer
  • Wide panoramic views

⏳ Which ticket sells out first?

Based on real demand:

  1. Huayna Picchu (very limited spots)
  2. Circuit 2 Classic
  3. Machu Picchu Mountain

This happens because:

  • Daily visitor limits
  • Fixed entry time slots
  • High international demand

Common mistake travelers make

Many visitors:

  • Buy any available ticket without checking
  • Don’t review the circuit
  • Miss key highlights

Real result:

  • No access to the classic photo spot
  • Limited access to important areas
  • Incomplete experience

How to choose the right ticket

Use this simple guide:

  • First time → Circuit 2 (Classic)
  • Adventure → Huayna Picchu
  • Scenic views → Machu Picchu Mountain

Official recommendations

  • Book in advance (at least 1–3 months)
  • Buy from the official Peruvian government website
  • Choose your circuit before purchasing

Why is this so important?

Because visiting Machu Picchu today works like this:

You’re not just choosing a ticket… you’re choosing your entire experience

And once inside, you cannot change your circuit.
